svg.title: Object Model — Texture
svg.desc: UML-style object model of pytex.texture: discrete and harmonic ODFs, pole and inverse pole figures, the kernel specification they share, and the reconstruction and residual reports produced by ODF inversion.
svg.text: Orientation distribution functions, pole figures, kernels, and inversion reports
composition - a required field: the owner cannot exist without it
association - an optional or defaulted field
* after a field name: the field holds a sequence
ProvenanceRecord is omitted: 98 classes carry it, on every result object.
Fields naming another card are listed first; the rest are summarized.
